theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_branchRef
theorems.claim: successful independent if/I64-case reference agrees with exact MC1 normal result, preserving any public prefix
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.exec_branchRef : ∀ {kind : NobleFoundation.BranchKind} {left : Bool} {p q : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.branchRef kind left p q zs = some zs' → ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.branchCode kind left p q) (pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs) t ↔ t = pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs'

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.branchRef_untaken
theorems.claim: changing only the untaken branch leaves if/I64-case reference outcomes unchanged
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.branchRef_untaken : ∀ (kind : NobleFoundation.BranchKind) (left : Bool) (selected other₁ other₂ : List NobleFoundation.AOp) (zs : List ℤ), NobleFoundation.branchRef kind left (if left = true then selected else other₁) (if left = true then other₁ else selected) zs = NobleFoundation.branchRef kind left (if left = true then selected else other₂) (if left = true then other₂ else selected) zs

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.branchVisits_selected
theorems.claim: selected-branch visit vector is [1,0] for left and [0,1] for right
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.branchVisits_selected : ∀ (left : Bool), NobleFoundation.branchVisits left = if left = true then [1, 0] else [0, 1]
